Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

Our patient, a male in their 50s with type 2 diabetes, was given DemoGluca, at a dose of 500mg, (third dose).
Treatment started on 2026-06-25.
About 6 days later, they developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter762@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
